name: Binghatti
verdict: Binghatti Holding is a private, family-owned Dubai property developer founded by Hussain Binghatti Aljbori in 2008 and chaired by his son Muhammad BinGhatti. Nothing found.
note: Chest sponsor (beneath Nissan) on Shabab Al Ahli's 2026/27 home kit from the club's launch gallery (14 Aug 2026); the club announced Binghatti as 'official Platinum Sponsor' for 2024-25 and Instagram posts of May 2025 (reel DKbpiK5OWU1) thank it for continued support.
